booth-fonts-specialist.description: BOOTH font SEO-copy specialist. Defaults to a limited-time free campaign (FREE_ACTIVE): a Japanese-first free-offer title/description opening with the offer, a BOOTH like CTA, validated tags including free-campaign tags, and the permanent paid copy state; no technical package, media, license, or upload QA.

creative-fabrica-fonts-specialist.description: Creative Fabrica font listing and SEO research specialist. Produces a Fonts-category listing with exactly 40 researched tags and clearly labelled engagement and purchase observations; live tag verification only when explicitly requested; no upload claim.

cm-fonts-specialist.description: Creative Market font listing specialist using the complete local Creative Market font corpus and deterministic tag-pattern bank; no long live-research loop.

font-final-visual-processor.description: Post-workflow processor for seller-replaced font images. Separates final raw images into 3:2 and 1:1 sets, preserves exact source copies, compresses JPEG delivery files, and writes an audit manifest without changing the raw files.

font-image-generator.description: Agent 27 visual handoff: selects a Saved family when needed, reviews metadata and the full glyph atlas, records factual description and observed vibe, writes four complete theme prompts, generates their matching primary and alternate thumbnails, and creates 12 support layouts with eligible family showcases in the random pool; Agent 13 owns factual specimen sheets.

font-prep-specialist.description: Agent 13 prepares OTF files only, creates one font-named ZIP, installs Agent 27's four generated thumbnails and 24 support designs for Agent 30, and renders factual specimen sheets.

font-rights-researcher.description: Standalone rights researcher for fonts staged in font-factory/input. Takes one research pass per staged folder (one family per folder), plans its Regular representative, and fans a red/amber/green verdict over the folder's files in rights-verdicts.json for the Input Inspector. Enforces evidence-domain and cross-holder rules through the tool, and publishes the tracked rights ledger with sync. Never edits fonts, manifests, listings, or the launch pipeline.

full-workflow.description: Strict active font launch: Agent 27 visual handoff, Agent 13 preparation, BOOTH, Creative Market, and Creative Fabrica in sequence. Pixiv and other marketplace stages are paused.

booth-pdf-maker.description: Builds a single-page Japanese branded trial-insert PDF from a BOOTH item URL, local font directory, trial URL, and New-Images squares thumbnail. No upload claim.

pinterest-font-preparer.description: Pinterest asset preparer. Validates and uploads every manifested Agent-27 template pin and ten Agent-30 composites to Vercel Blob, records product URLs and the description, and writes public-urls.md; does not publish Pins.

daily-pinterest-run.description: Daily Pinterest pipeline: picks 10 ready fonts with 14-day exclusion, writes per-font title/description/alt/keywords after reading the font's pin history from the ledger, and validates/assembles the staggered buffer.csv plus pins.csv fallback. Import stays a human step.

booth-font.description: Run the booth-fonts-specialist agent to generate a BOOTH font listing for a font product.
booth-font.template: Please run the booth-fonts-specialist agent to generate an optimized BOOTH listing (campaign mode FREE_ACTIVE unless told otherwise) for this font product: {input}

creative-fabrica-font.description: Run the Creative Fabrica Font Listing and SEO Research Specialist on a font product.
creative-fabrica-font.template: Please run the creative-fabrica-fonts-specialist agent to generate a Creative Fabrica Fonts listing with a product title of no more than 30 characters, never adding the category word font/fonts, exactly 40 researched tags, live category/tag/PDP evidence, and clearly labelled engagement and purchase signals: {input}

cm-font.description: Run Agent 2 for a bounded, fact-checked Creative Market font listing using current taxonomy and product facts.
cm-font.template: Please run cm-fonts-specialist with the supplied final name, product facts, description, slug, and unified product number. Follow agents/agent-2-fonts-specialist.md and agents/reference/AGENTS-annex-listing.md: perform the bounded current Creative Market research pass, create exactly 30 defensible tags, run the validator, and return the exact output path. Do not upload or publish: {input}

font-final-images.description: Run Agent 30 standalone for older prepared products; full-workflow now includes final image processing when inputs are ready.
font-final-images.template: Please run Agent 30 standalone for the supplied older prepared product. Follow agents/agent-30-font-final-visual-processor.md and use the supplied product-preparation output plus visuals/New-Images folder. Use the named thumbnail pair and exact readiness requirements in that spec; do not use vision to identify a thumbnail. Create exact source copies, optimized JPEG delivery files, and final-image-manifest.md. Do not alter raw images, font files, or metadata; do not invoke full-workflow and make no upload claim.

font-images.description: Run Agent 27 before font preparation. It writes the visual handoff and generates all four final thumbnails from their paired theme prompts and specimens.
font-images.template: Run the registered font-image-generator using the exact selected source workspace, user-supplied final name and description when provided, and relevant facts. In /full-workflow, if no exact source was supplied, first select and stage one family with python3 bin/stage_saved_font.py --random. Follow agents/agent-27-font-image-generator.md and agents/reference/AGENTS-annex-visual-handoff.md. Inspect the font metadata and every page of its complete mapped-glyph atlas before recording a factual product description and observed vibe. Produce two lettering references, four primary and alternate thumbnail prompts in theme.txt, and use the built-in image-generation tool to generate each thumbnail with its matching specimen. Also render 12 eligible support layouts at both ratios; eligible family showcases are in the same random pool, not guaranteed. Factual specimen sheets belong to Agent 13. Do not leave thumbnail creation as a manual seller step. Finish with READY FOR FONT PREP HANDOFF and the exact prepared_visuals path: {input}

font-prep.description: Prepare OTF files only, create one `{FontName}.zip` archive, install Agent 27's generated thumbnails and 24 support images for Agent 30, and render factual specimen sheets.
font-prep.template: Run the registered font-prep-specialist agent with the exact font workspace, final name, unified product number, and Agent-27 prepared_visuals path. Follow agents/agent-13-font-prep-specialist.md. Prepare OTF file(s) only and one `{FontName}.zip` containing the font-named folder and its OTF files. Do not output TTF, WOFF, WOFF2, or separate Commercial-Use/Personal-Use archives. Write the description at the output root outside the ZIP, install the four generated thumbnails and 24 support designs unchanged with bin/install_support_images.py --include-thumbnails, and render factual specimen sheets. Do not generate or redesign thumbnail art. Agent 30 processes the images after marketplace stages. Report the preparation output path and validation result; do not claim upload or publication: {input}

font-rights-check.description: Run the standalone font rights researcher over the unmarked fonts staged in font-factory/input.
font-rights-check.template: Please run the font-rights-researcher agent on the staged fonts under font-factory/input. Take the queue from `python3 bin/font_rights.py status --unmarked` — it lists FOLDERS, and the staged folder is the unit of research: one family per folder, one web pass per folder, never one per weight. Per folder run `python3 bin/font_rights.py plan --folder <N>` to get the representative (its Regular/normal cut) and the family/holder/fsType/licence it claims, do ONE search (serper, with `'<family>' (myfonts OR fonts.com OR creativefabrica OR dafont OR fontspace)` as the single sweep query), and write the verdict with `bin/font_rights.py write … --fanout` so it covers the whole folder. Fetch a page only when the verdict would be clear, because a grant has to be read while red and amber both mean do not ship. States: claimed (still sold by an active holder, needs a live evidence URL on a shop, the holder's own domain, or a type-rights reference — the tool refuses a name-table scraper or an unrelated page), orphan (no holder and no licence found — unlicensed, not safe, needs 2 searched avenues, never high confidence), clear (a grant quote the tool verifies verbatim in each binary, or an author reached this run). Drain every folder in natural order unless the user names one. Finish the run with `python3 bin/font_rights.py sync` so the verdicts survive the gitignored staging in outputs/research/font-rights-ledger.json. Never edit a font, a manifest, in-use.txt, or a listing; sync is the only thing you may write under outputs/. Never delete duplicates. Report the counts per state, every clear with its evidence, and tell the user to press Refresh in the Input Inspector. Request: {input}

full-workflow.description: Run the shared five-stage sequential font launch, including Agent 30 final image processing when the image readiness check passes. Pixiv and other marketplace stages are paused.
full-workflow.template: Run the registered full-workflow agent. Follow agents/agent-28-full-workflow.md as the shared source of truth. Execute 1) font-image-generator (Agent 27), 2) font-prep-specialist (Agent 13), 3) cm-fonts-specialist (Agent 2), 4) creative-fabrica-fonts-specialist (Agent 29), and then 5) font-final-visual-processor (Agent 30) only after bin/check_new_images.py confirms readiness. Keep stages strictly sequential, verifying each before continuing. Agent 27 generates all four thumbnails from the exact theme prompts and matching specimens; Agent 13 installs them with the 24 support designs. Preserve an exact supplied source; otherwise have Agent 27 start with python3 bin/stage_saved_font.py --random, then inspect metadata and the complete glyph atlas and record the description and observed vibe before continuing. Do not invoke Pixiv or other paused stages, and do not claim upload/publication: {input}

booth-pdf-maker.description: Build a single-page Japanese branded trial-insert PDF from a BOOTH item URL, font directory, trial URL, and New-Images squares thumbnail.
booth-pdf-maker.template: Please run the booth-pdf-maker agent to build a one-page portrait trial-insert PDF. Use the BOOTH item URL, the local font directory, and the trial URL supplied here: {input}. Take the product image from {font-dir}/visuals/New-Images/squares/ (prefer thumbnail_main, else the first lexicographic image — no vision). Set Japanese customer copy with restrained top branding, a huge specimen in the product font, a single large GET YOUR FONT button linking to the trial URL with the URL also printed in plain text, a short about-trial section, a secondary BOOTH full-version link, and a small shop footer. Do not put a please-like-on-BOOTH CTA in the PDF. Write outputs/booth-pdfs/{slug}-trial-insert.pdf via bin/make_booth_trial_pdf.py. No upload claim.

pinterest-prepare.description: Validate and upload the complete manifested Pinterest image set, record product URLs, and write all public links.
pinterest-prepare.template: Run the pinterest-font-preparer agent on the supplied fonts. Match each to its outputs/font-preparation folder, record supplied product URLs, choose a board, then validate and upload every manifested template pin and ten final-image composites from visuals/New-Images/pinterest/ to Blob. Use manifest-driven counts, write all links to public-urls.md, and report image URLs and missing product URLs. Do not claim Pins were published: {input}

pinterest-daily.description: Run the daily Pinterest pipeline: pick 10 fonts, write pin copy with tag rotation, assemble the staggered bulk-import CSV.
pinterest-daily.template: Please run the daily-pinterest-run agent to produce the daily buffer.csv (plus pins.csv fallback) for tomorrow (or the date given here) from the 10 randomly picked ready fonts, reading each font's pin history first: {input}
